purpose: The start file: checks the Python version and curses, then calls leeravontuur/__main__.main().
details: Runs at import/exec time (no functions): exits with a friendly Dutch message if Python is older than 3.10 or curses is missing (with the pip command for Windows or others), otherwise imports main from leeravontuur.__main__ and exits with its return code. The double-click files (leeravontuur-win.bat, -mac.command, -linux.sh) start this file; oefeningen.py (the old name) runs it.
module_docstring: Leeravontuur starten: python3 leeravontuur.py (hulp: python3 leeravontuur.py --help)
